hints.title: Remember what you have seen
hints.body: A value is a duplicate exactly when it has already appeared.

hints.title: Set membership
hints.body: Insert values into a set. If an insertion finds an existing value, return `true`.

hints.title: Alternative
hints.body: Sorting places equal values next to each other, at the cost of `O(n log n)` time.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
seen = empty set
for value in nums:
    if value in seen: return true
    add value to seen
return false
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
